# Logan Goodwin

Official personal and creative hub for Logan Goodwin, an author, songwriter, technologist, and independent commentator based in Somersworth, New Hampshire.

Primary sections:
- /about/ — personal biography and brand story
- /books/ — featured books and publishing links
- /music/ — original music library
- /commentary/ — current events, technology, humor, and civil discussion
- /technology/ — cybersecurity credentials and project pathways
- /media/ — social, video, publishing, and professional channels
- /contact/ — official contact form

Full publishing catalog: https://frontlinetechconsulting.com/
